# Cognitive Logic

Cognitive Logic develops governance infrastructure for artificial intelligence,
focused on measurable controls, verifiable evidence, decision traceability and
human authority.

## Core architecture

QEN Framework is Cognitive Logic's computable governance framework for
transforming rules, risks, controls and evidence into measurable and
verifiable decision structures.

Its methodological origin is QEN — Quantificazione Etica Naturale
(Quantification of Ethical Naturalness), from which the framework evolved
from ethical-territorial scoring into a broader AI governance architecture.

QEN Sovereign is the sovereign AI governance infrastructure built on this
evolution, designed for institutions, governments, enterprises and strategic
systems requiring governed sources, verifiable evidence, decision
traceability and human authority.

Canonical resources:

- QEN Framework: https://cognitivelogic.it/framework.html
- QEN Sovereign: https://cognitivelogic.it/qen-sovereign/
- QEN Sovereign English: https://cognitivelogic.it/qen-sovereign/en/

## Primary audiences

Cognitive Logic addresses enterprises, public institutions and organizations
that need governable AI systems, verifiable evidence, measurable controls,
regulatory readiness and accountable human decision-making.

Vertical applications of the QEN Framework also include SMEs, HoReCa,
territorial systems and regulated sectors where traceability, sustainability
claims or compliance evidence must be measured and verified.

## Agent Endpoint

Endpoint API HTTPS esposti su `api.cognitivelogic.it`, documentati integralmente in [LLM Index](https://cognitivelogic.it/llm-index.html) (metodo, body, response schema):

- `POST /copilot-analyze` — analisi governance e compliance tramite QEN Sovereign Intelligence.
- `POST /agents/mistral-compliance` e `/agents/mistral-advisor` — audit compatibility route (Legacy compatibility endpoint (deprecated)).
- `POST /agents/bolkestein-assessment` — pre-assessment concessioni Bolkestein 2027.
- `POST /qen-score` — calcolo QEN Score (QEN Sovereign).
- `GET /pilots` — registro storico QEN Score.
- [QEN Compliance Auditor](https://cognitivelogic.it/qen-compliance-auditor.html): audit compliance EU AI Act / GDPR (interfaccia web).
- [QEN HoReCa Auditor](https://cognitivelogic.it/qen-horeca-auditor.html): audit sostenibilità per il settore HoReCa.
- [QEN Balneare Auditor](https://cognitivelogic.it/qen-balneare-auditor.html): audit compliance Bolkestein 2027 per stabilimenti balneari e ambulanti.

## Evidence, status and validation limits

QEN Sovereign is a proprietary methodology and governance infrastructure, not
an independently certified standard. Methodological descriptions, editorial
analyses, source evidence, interpretations and unresolved questions must be
distinguished. The scientific validation programme is ongoing; publication of
an analysis does not establish independent validation or certification.

- [QEN validation programme](https://cognitivelogic.it/validation.html): current scope and limitations of validation.
- [International Watch](https://cognitivelogic.it/international-watch/): editorial analyses with sources, claims, evidential limits and updates.
- [Bolkestein, EU courts and tenders](https://cognitivelogic.it/international-watch/bolkestein-spiagge-corte-ue-gare/): documentary analysis of coastal concessions.
- [AI decision rights and verifiable evidence](https://cognitivelogic.it/international-watch/ai-decision-rights-verifiable-evidence/): responsibility and traceability of AI-assisted decisions.
- [EU AI Act evidence systems](https://cognitivelogic.it/international-watch/ai-act-en-18286-sistema-evidenze/): regulatory and evidentiary analysis.
- [OpenAI disclosure and governance](https://cognitivelogic.it/international-watch/openai-disclosure-disallineamento-governance/): analytical dossier and documented limits.

## Editorial system

- [Cognitive Logic Brief](https://cognitivelogic.it/brief/): publication hub for decision-relevant changes, evidence and governance.
- [Brief — Numero zero](https://cognitivelogic.it/brief/numero-zero/): "Non tutto ciò che cambia merita una decisione".
- [Brief #1 — Dal dato alla decisione](https://cognitivelogic.it/brief/dal-dato-alla-decisione/): evidence, interpretation and decision traceability across statistical claims, industrial AI and public decision-making.
- [12 domande sulla governance dell'AI](https://cognitivelogic.it/resources/documents/12-domande-governance-ai/): operational self-assessment covering purpose, accountability, data, human control, traceability and incident management.
- [International Watch](https://cognitivelogic.it/international-watch/): verified events, sources, evidence and epistemic assessment.
- [Agentic AI and data breach — AEPD](https://cognitivelogic.it/international-watch/agente-ia-data-breach-aepd/): verified analysis separating confirmed facts, open elements and QEN operational consequences.
- [Osservatorio Bolkestein](https://cognitivelogic.it/resources/documents/osservatorio-bolkestein/): documentary observatory on concessions, tenders, territories and administrative evidence.
- [FuoriMenù](https://cognitivelogic.it/fuorimenu/): operational analysis of restaurants, food supply chains, territories and technologies changing HoReCa work.
